LiquidUI design and interaction attribution

The pathways shell, guided-conversation presentation, search composer,
adjacent/modal reader, preserved reading state, and playback interaction are
adapted from Iris's LiquidUI standalone edition of 4 October 2026, supplied
in lq-ai-liquidui-chat-standalone.zip.

The contributed application is licensed under Apache License 2.0; its license
is retained in this directory. The original captured documentation corpus,
copied pathway map, search ranking, and fixed answer strings are not shipped
by this integration. Current repository documents, the existing pathway map,
Pagefind, and the shared Astro rendering pipeline supply those functions.

The site's visual design is the proposed LQ.AI interface redesign, which uses
the reader's own system fonts. No font from the contributed archive, and no
webfont of any kind, is shipped.
